title: amu-pgvector: PostgreSQL + pgvector reference implementation of Lineage-Aware Memory Governance
description: Reference implementation of Lineage-Aware Memory Governance (Sangaraju & Vissa, IEEE Access, DOI 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3730363) on PostgreSQL + pgvector. Postgres row-level security enforces S(a) subset P(d) -- an agent may reuse a cached analytical result only if every sensitive column in its derivation lineage is in the requester's permitted set -- as a database-level gate, not an application-side filter.
